subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can say: I want to be a … / an …
I can choose a or an.

tf.why: Right! A pilot flies a plane.

tf.s: We say: I want to be a artist.
tf.why: Artist starts with a vowel sound, so we say an artist.

tf.s: We say: I want to be an astronaut.
A firefighter needs a palette and a brush.
tf.why: An artist uses a palette. A firefighter uses fire boots.
Yes! A stethoscope is a doctor's object.

tf.s: We use an before a consonant sound, like an pilot.
tf.why: We use a before a consonant sound: a pilot.

tf.s: A builder uses a helmet and plans.
tf.why: Well done! Builders use helmets and plans.

tf.s: A teacher works with a board and desks.
tf.why: Right! A teacher uses a board and desks.

boxes.q: Choose: I want to be ___ artist.
boxes.why: Artist starts with a vowel sound: an artist.

boxes.q: Choose: I want to be ___ nurse.
boxes.why: Nurse starts with a consonant sound: a nurse.
An artist paints with a palette.

boxes.q: Who helps keep people safe on the street?
boxes.why: A police officer keeps people safe.

boxes.q: Which word starts with a vowel sound?
boxes.why: Astronaut starts with a vowel sound, so we say an.

an + vowel sound, a + consonant sound.
